info.name: Radiology STT API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Specialized Speech-to-Text for Radiology service.

## Setup
1. Import this collection into Postman.
2. Set the collection variable `base_url` (default: `http://localhost:8013`).
3. For `/transcribe` and `/transcribe/chunk`, attach an audio file (wav/mp3/m4a/webm/ogg/flac) in the `file` form field.

## Notes on WebSocket / live mic
Postman does support WebSocket (New > WebSocket Request), but it cannot capture audio from your microphone. To test the live-streaming endpoint and the mic capture path, use `tests/test_live_mic.py` provided with the service.

request.description: Upload a complete audio recording and get the full radiology-normalized transcription, segments, and timing metadata.
Stateless single-chunk transcription. Use this if your client wants to send short audio slices via REST instead of WebSocket.

Real-time streaming endpoint. URL: `ws://localhost:8013/api/v1/ws/transcribe`.

Protocol:
  1. After connect, send a JSON text frame: `{"type": "start", "sample_rate": 16000, "channels": 1, "language": "en"}`
  2. Server replies with `{"type": "ready", ...}`.
  3. Send binary frames containing little-endian int16 PCM samples at the declared sample rate.
  4. Server emits `{"type": "partial", "text": ...}` messages every ~chunk_seconds.
  5. Send `{"type": "stop"}` (or close) to finalize. Server returns `{"type": "final", "text": ..., "segments": [...]}`.

Postman cannot record microphone audio, so use `tests/test_live_mic.py` (Python) provided with this service to exercise this endpoint.
